description: This file defines a Java class OpenmrsMetadataHandler that extends DefaultMetadataHandler. It provides methods to check the existence of a database table and to retrieve tables metadata, specifically tailored for the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: OpenmrsMetadataHandler
classes.description: A class that extends DefaultMetadataHandler to customize metadata handling for OpenMRS database tables.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists within the schema in the database metadata.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata of tables matching criteria within the database schema.
